parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The query content. Exact match is used.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time. The date is in ISO 8601 format and uses UTC+0 time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.
> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: **1** to **100000**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: **20**. Maximum value: **50**. Valid values: any integer from **1** to **50**.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The date is in ISO 8601 format and uses UTC+0 time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task execution status. Valid values:

- **Complte**: Complete.
- **Refreshing**: Prefetching.
- **Failed**: Prefetch failed.
